name: Grand Hyatt Seoul
positioning: Grand Hyatt hotel on the slopes of Namsan in Seoul's Hannam-dong, spread across 23 landscaped acres with the feel of a leisure resort in the city
best_for: Travelers who want resort-style pools, spa and sports facilities in central Seoul
Guests who want rooms with Han River, Namsan or skyline views

facts.text: The hotel is set against the backdrop of the Han River and Mount Namsan.
The hotel is a 20-floor glass building on the slopes of Namsan in Hannam-dong.
The hotel is minutes from downtown Seoul, Myeongdong and Itaewon.
The hotel is close to cultural attractions such as the Leeum Samsung Museum of Art and Bukchon Hanok Village.
Guest rooms have interiors accented with Korean cultural inspiration.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic views of the Seoul skyline.
The Presidential Suite has panoramic views of the Han River and Mount Namsan.
Grand Club access includes a dedicated concierge, a daily breakfast buffet, and evening cocktails and canapes.
The indoor pool on the Garden Level has a nature-friendly interior with trees.
In winter the outdoor pool becomes an ice skating rink.
322 Sowol-ro is the hotel's gourmet alley, with four restaurants: Steak House, Teppan, Kauri and Tenkai.
The Gallery lounge has art, music and large floor-to-ceiling windows.

highlights.text: The hotel spreads across 23 landscaped acres, giving it the feel of a leisure resort in the heart of the city.
The Club Olympus wellness center has a sauna, an indoor pool, an outdoor pool with a whirlpool, and squash and tennis courts.
The outdoor swimming pool overlooks the Han River.
The Spa has nine independent treatment suites and a European botanical garden concept.
Room decor includes black-and-white fish paintings, hanok photographs and geometric wood patterns reminiscent of bojagi wrapping cloths.

considerations.text: The hotel sits up a hill; the walk up is steep and takes about 20 minutes.
Children under 13 are not allowed in the Grand Club Lounge during evening cocktails.
The hotel's kids' lounge is unsupervised.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: Grand Hyatt Seoul
